notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 : National Race Track & Vibrations
notes.notes:
Hello drivers,

Here's a new update for Hot Lap Racing ! 😉

Patch 1.1.2 is bringing a couple of new features:


 Vibration support!
 An option in the menu to set different levels of vibration or activate/disactivate them. 
 New track : National Park Racetrack


The National Park Racetrack is (fictively) set in Malaysia and offers 6 brand-new layouts on a fast-paced track going through a cool forestry environment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/59e22124c0e800134f0373b034b1039b590c9d61.png

Not coming alone, this update comes with an amazing discount to get you on track if you didn't got the game yet! That's the perfect time to get it right before Christmas! Enjoy a big sale of 40% off during the Steam Winter Sale! 


All the ZGS and MaxEnt teams are wishing you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! 
See you in 2025 for more updates!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 - Steam Deck, Wheel Support & Crossplay
notes.notes:
Hey drivers,

Here's our major update for November! We're bringing crossplay to Hot Lap Racing, and it starts right now!

If you didn't get the game yet, we're running a special discount for you this week ♥

Online


 CROSS-PLATFORM: Nintendo Switch, Steam and Epic Games Store players can now play together online.
 When you can't find a quick game, you're now invited to create a lobby instead.
 Added a button to select your online region directly in Public / Private game modes.


New Devices
  Full Steam Deck support! Verified button is ongoing, but should be there soon! 
 Added Wheel support and wheel adjustment options!

About wheel support, we have worked on a global basis to cover as many wheels as we could.
We have tried wheel support on a couple of modern wheels such as TRS 300 Trustmaster or Logitech G29. Don't hesitate to share your feedback and your wheel model in the Steam forum so we can help getting more wheels supported by the game!

Gameplay


 Slipstream: The slipstream phenomenon has been increased.
 Slipstream: A.I. should take better account of slipstream.
 Track exits should be better calculated, more precise and less penalizing.
 In local multiplayer, players can now play with the camera inside the car.
 “Manual” standing start now expects the player to shift into first gear (shifting into first gear will no longer be automatic).


Bugfix


 Main menu music should reactivate normally if player skips tutorial (on first game launch).
 Fix player 2+ options navigation in local multi if player 2+ was a keyboard.
 The LolaB02/00 should display its RPM/KMHs correctly in cockpit view.
 Various rebinding bugfixes.


It's your time to race once more!
See you soon for another update...

Zero Games Studios & MaxEnt teams!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is Now Live - 3 New Cars!
notes.notes:
Hello drivers,

Get ready to try your driving skills with three new cars in today's Patch 1.1! In addition to three new cars, we've also added a new Overview system where you can get a better look inside and outside of the car. We've also made some bug fixes to provide you with the best experience in the motorsports universe that we can.

The New Cars

RBM 4LM JTC

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/66643148f40876868b75fb759e10ba82375a9827.png

The 4LM in the Japanese GT Championship is a car with a strong overall performance, with a top speed higher than any of its rivals'. However, the choice of rear-wheel drive over all-wheel drive for other championship contenders makes it less efficient on winding circuits.

Stuotgarten 191S GT3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/1f5f3fe1c9c2de6be6b6f8bd776a6bbcdb47e53c.png

The 191S has long been a regular in the GT3 field. In fact, it's one of the most common cars in these championships. Although on paper some of its rivals are faster, it remains a powerful, robust and well-balanced car, and above all one of the easiest to maintain and repair.

Duqueine D08

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/b11b05df430add759e6fdfd2c3c25abac1f0ea84.png

Duqueine Engineering's D08 prototype is eligible for a large number of championships. The car has won several constructors' and drivers' championships since its debut in 2020, and many teams have adopted it for its performance and reliability.

Full Patch Notes


 3 new cars available immediately in all solo game mode and in the Career championships:
     - RBM 4LM JTC
     - Stuotgarten 191S GT3
     - Duqueine D08
 The Feed Racing School tutorials in Career have been tweaked to make it more accessible and easier to complete.
 A new "Overview" feature allows you to get a better look inside/outside of the car in the car selection menu.
 Fixed the display issue on Electric race events in Career mode.
 Various bugfixes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/4d08429d45f75ed7797facfa6c1bf34ad6160d40.png

Update Hot Lap Racing today and check out all the updated content!

Thank you very much,

ZGS & ME teams

notes.title: Game Update 1.0.4 and game Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hello drivers,

Thank you for the warming welcome that you've made to Hot Lap Racing this latest weeks!
Based on community feedback we have worked relentlessly to deliver version 1.0.4. of the game!
Expect a small roadmap and more patches on the way. We've really cool updates coming up soon...
All the team is involved to work and provide you the best experience in the motorsports universe we can, so that's why we're glad to share our first patchnote! 

On top of that, here's the first roadmap of content and updates for Hot Lap Racing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/12342c0550706171cbdfb5a52b2b2718014cb353.png

Patch 1.0.4
Bug Fixes

  Achievements are now unlocking : "Salty Track", "Is there a bonus scene after the credits?" and "Samir, you're breaking the car!"
 Performance improvements
 AI Improvements
 Career mode crash fix
 Other minor bug fixes


Quality Of Life Improvements

 Support for metric and imperial units (km/h or mph)
 New option to select online region for optimal latency
 New option to select camera stiffness
 Better rebinding options for controllers.


New Content

 New electric event in the Career Mode, featuring the Renault R5 Turbo 3E !
 New driver : Frank Porté Ruiz. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/aa13a0883d681cc1f02cb19be985c6ada969fbc1.jpg

Frank Porté Ruiz is a F4 driver that is driving a Mygale F3R, an Mygale F4 gen.2, an Opel Calibra V6 and a Lola B02/00. Frank will appear randomly in the following championships:  F4 Allstars, German Touring Championship, Extreme US open wheel in the carreer mode. Beat him to unlock his entry in your Driver Codex!


 New liveries : Frank is coming with his very own liveries for his cars: Lola B02/00, the Mygale F4. Gen2, The Mygale F3R and the Opel Calibra V6.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/0760dd9534e6cca5db9bd563727d5bf9661f8a82.gif


 New helmets : We've added a couple of helmets inspired by some of the in-game drivers! Find the helmets from Augustin Bernier, Carrie Schreiner, Frank Porté Ruiz and more !


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/43b95439ac5039356f77cd985094610a21d5b895.gif

Update Hot Lap Racing today and check out all the updated content!

Thank you very much,

ZGS & ME teams
